close_reason: Removed redundant #[must_use] from 6 Result-returning fns/trait methods (validate_path, validate_path_with_profile, build_path, build_path_with_config, check_revocation, check_revocation_against_anchor). Result's own type-level #[must_use] handles this.
description:
Pass 2 idiom finding under epic PKIX-qwzx.

`Result<T, E>` is already annotated `#[must_use]` in libcore. Adding
`#[must_use]` to a function that returns `Result` is redundant — `rustc` already
fires the `unused_must_use` lint on dropped `Result` values regardless of
function-level annotation.

Sites:

`pkix-path/src/lib.rs`:
- line 849: `#[must_use = \"path validation result must be checked\"]` on
  `pub fn validate_path(...) -> Result<ValidatedPath>`
- line 931: `#[must_use = \"path validation result must be checked\"]` on
  `pub fn validate_path_with_profile(...) -> Result<ValidatedPath>`

`pkix-path-builder/src/lib.rs`:
- line 398: `#[must_use = \"path building result must be checked\"]` on
  `pub fn build_path(...) -> Result<Vec<Certificate>>`
- line 416: `#[must_use = \"path building result must be checked\"]` on
  `pub fn build_path_with_config(...) -> Result<Vec<Certificate>>`

`pkix-revocation/src/lib.rs`:
- line 309: `#[must_use = \"revocation check result must not be silently discarded\"]`
  on trait method `check_revocation` returning `crate::Result<()>`
- line 352: same on default-impl trait method `check_revocation_against_anchor`
  returning `crate::Result<()>`

The custom message strings are individually nice — but the underlying lint fires
either way, so the message is unreachable in practice (the default
`#[must_use]` from `Result` triggers first with its own \"unused Result that must
be used\" message).

Fix: drop `#[must_use]` on these six sites. Keep documentation in the function's
rustdoc if the warning message carried useful prose. Modern clippy does not
flag this as redundant by default, but `clippy::redundant_must_use` is in
nursery.

(Trait-method `#[must_use]` in particular is a footgun: it can be silently
ignored when the trait is consumed via dyn dispatch, while the underlying
`Result` type-level `#[must_use]` always works.)
title: (IDIOM) P3: redundant #[must_use] on Result-returning fns and trait methods
